theorems.name: Submission.chart_tangential_coefficient_contDiffOn
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (V : Set (Rn n)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N) (u : Rn n → Rn N), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ψ V → (∀ x ∈ V, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ x)) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u V → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x ↦ Ring.inverse (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ ψ x) ∘L fderiv ℝ ψ x) (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ ψ x) (u x))) V
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
